description: This file defines the RpcSession class and related components for managing RPC sessions in Android, including connection setup, protocol versioning, and session management.

classes.name: RpcSession
classes.description: Manages a group of RPC connections between a client and server, handling connection setup, protocol negotiation, and session lifecycle.

classes.name: RpcSession::EventListener
classes.description: Interface for session event callbacks, such as thread termination events.

classes.name: RpcSession::WaitForShutdownListener
classes.description: Implements EventListener to wait for session shutdown events.

classes.name: RpcSession::RpcConnection
classes.description: Represents an individual RPC transport connection within a session.

classes.name: RpcSession::ExclusiveConnection
classes.description: Manages exclusive access to a specific RPC connection.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new RpcSession with default or custom configuration.

methods.name: setMaxIncomingThreads
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming threads for handling callbacks.

methods.name: getMaxIncomingThreads
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of incoming threads.

methods.name: setMaxOutgoingConnections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of outgoing connections.

methods.name: getMaxOutgoingThreads
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of outgoing threads.

methods.name: setProtocolVersion
methods.description: Sets the protocol version for the session.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Gets the negotiated protocol version.

methods.name: setFileDescriptorTransportMode
methods.description: Configures how file descriptors are transported.

methods.name: getFileDescriptorTransportMode
methods.description: Retrieves current file descriptor transport mode.

methods.name: setupUnixDomainClient
methods.description: Initializes a Unix domain socket client connection.

methods.name: setupUnixDomainSocketBootstrapClient
methods.description: Connects to an RPC server over a bootstrap socket.

methods.name: setupVsockClient
methods.description: Connects to an RPC server over a vsock.

methods.name: setupInetClient
methods.description: Connects to an RPC server over TCP/IP.

methods.name: setupPreconnectedClient
methods.description: Uses an existing connection to set up an RPC client.

methods.name: addNullDebuggingClient
methods.description: Creates a dummy connection for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getRootObject
methods.description: Retrieves the root binder object from the remote server.

methods.name: getRemoteMaxThreads
methods.description: Queries the maximum number of threads supported by the remote server.

methods.name: getCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves the session's certificate data.

methods.name: shutdownAndWait
methods.description: Shuts down the session, optionally waiting for completion.

methods.name: transact
methods.description: Performs an RPC transaction.

methods.name: sendDecStrong
methods.description: Decrements strong reference count for a binder.

methods.name: hasActiveRequests
methods.description: Checks if there are active requests being processed.

methods.name: readId
methods.description: Reads session identifier.

methods.name: preJoinThreadOwnership
methods.description: Transfers ownership of a thread to the session.

methods.name: preJoinSetup
methods.description: Prepares a thread for joining the session.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a thread to the session.
